operators.name: custom_reshape
semantics: Exactly mirrors torch.reshape(input, shape).
The shape parameter is a tuple of ints; for the two reshape calls, shape is (-1, input.size(-1)) and self.mel_shape respectively.
Preserves data bytes and returns a view when possible, matching PyTorch semantics.
Input tensor is on CUDA; output on same device and dtype.

operators.name: custom_stft
semantics: Exactly mirrors torch.stft(input, n_fft=n_fft, hop_length=hop_length, win_length=win_length, return_complex=True).
All other stft parameters (window=None, center=True, pad_mode='reflect', normalized=False, onesided=None, align_to_window=None) take their default values, except return_complex set to True.
Uses a Hann window by default because window=None.
Computes complex STFT with output shape (batch, n_fft//2+1, num_frames) where num_frames = 1 + (input.size(-1) - n_fft) // hop_length due to center=True and default pad_mode='reflect'.
Input tensor is on CUDA; output on same device and dtype complex64.
Uses torch.reshape with shape (-1, last_dim).
Last dim is x.size(-1) which is the original number of samples (16384).
Output shape (1024, 16384) for the given input.
Dtype and device unchanged (torch.float32 on cuda:0).

reference_steps.source: x = torch.stft(x, n_fft=self.n_fft, hop_length=self.hop_length, win_length=self.win_length, return_complex=True)
semantics: Uses torch.stft with return_complex=True and other parameters default.
n_fft=4096, hop_length=512, win_length=4096.
Input shape (1024, 16384).
Output shape (1024, 2049, 33) with dtype torch.complex64 on cuda:0.
Uses torch.reshape with shape self.mel_shape = (1024, 2049, -1).
Input is the STFT output shape (1024, 2049, 33).
Output shape inferred as (1024, 2049, 33).
Because the input is contiguous, reshape is a no-op view returning same tensor.
Dtype and device unchanged.
Returns the reshaped STFT tensor of shape (1024, 2049, 33), dtype torch.complex64, device cuda:0.
